messages.content: 已知函数 $f(x)$ 的定义域为 $I$，若对于任意 $x_1\in I$，存在位移的 $x_2\in I$ 使得 $f(x_1)f(x_2)=1$，则成为 $f(x)$ 是区间 $I$ 上的可倒函数。若存在正数 $t$ 使得 $r(x)=kx^2+4x-1(k>0)$ 在其定义域 $[0,t]$ 上是可倒函数，则 $k$ 的取值范围是？

We have a function $f(x)$ with domain $I$. It is called an "invertible function" (可倒函数) on $I$ if for any $x_1 \in I$, there exists $x_2 \in I$ such that $f(x_1) f(x_2) = 1$.

The phrase "存在位移的" (there exists a "shifted" or translated) seems odd. Maybe it's a typo and should be "存在惟一的" (there exists a unique) or just "存在" (there exists).

Actually, I think the problem states: for any $x_1 \in I$, there exists $x_2 \in I$ such that $f(x_1) f(x_2) = 1$. This means the function is "invertible" in the sense that for every value $f(x_1)$, there's an $x_2$ in the domain such that $f(x_2) = 1/f(x_1)$.

So the condition is: for every $y \in f(I)$, we have $1/y \in f(I)$.

This means: the range of $f$ on $I$ is closed under taking reciprocals.
